description: Reviews Theourgia commands that run code through an external interpreter, delete blocks, install log segments, or change the committed store or a writer's drafts, while leaving the read-only verbs (outline, search, refs, read, grep, log, diff, check and the exports) unmatched.
name: Theourgia command protection
saferAlternatives: Use the read-only verbs (outline, search, refs, read) to inspect the store before changing it.
Keep external eval runners off (THEOURGIA_RUNNERS unset) unless a task needs one.
